desc:
🦫 Capybaras. With jackhammers. And dynamite. 💥

Dig straight down, smash every block into gold, and build a crew of capybaras who never stop mining. How deep can YOU go?

⛏️ SMASH — Aim your pickaxe and break through layer after layer. Blocks crack, crumble and burst!
🦫 RECRUIT — Miners, jackhammers, dynamite throwers and more. They keep digging while you upgrade, shop, or just watch.
💎 POWER UP — Mine diamonds and grow a huge skill tree: faster swings, thunder strikes, shockwaves, even a GIANT capybara.
🏺 DISCOVER — Ancient relics are hidden deep underground. Every one you find is a permanent bonus.
♻️ REBIRTH — Dig deep enough, rebirth for Gems, and come back stronger every run.
🏆 COMPETE — Climb the global leaderboard, then open the player list and tap View to watch other mines live.

📱 PC, mobile and controller. Progress saves automatically.
🔄 New skills, relics and capybaras keep coming — 👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to catch every update!
